propositions: The _env_int helper in binding_lifecycle.py performs a direct os.environ.get ambient read for RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE that must be eliminated by switching to the public resolve_absent_retire_grace() facade accessor.

The resolve_absent_retire_grace() accessor already exists in rebar._config_sources and is re-exported via rebar.config with identical semantics (env key RECONCILER_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE, default 3, minimum 1 clamp).

Removing the _env_int helper and its only caller (the note_absent read) eliminates the last two ambient config/env reads from binding_lifecycle.py, allowing LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS whitelist to reach empty state and close the RP-04 config-ownership drain.

The _DEFAULT_ABSENT_RETIRE_GRACE constant must be retained as a module-level plain constant because it is aliased by binding_store.py and asserted by test_no_resurrection_after_confirmed_delete_3b5f.py.

Absence-retire grace behavior must be byte-preserved after the cut: default to 3, clamp minimum 1, treat malformed/absent env as default, honor valid set values, and retire binding at exactly grace consecutive 404s.
